facet_score: weighted mean of all primary and secondary contributions assigned to the facet
domain_score: mean of the five facet scores within the domain, unless later calibration supplies empirical facet weights
rules: Do not interpret percentiles until a real normative sample exists.
Do not use AI to calculate trait scores.
AI narrative receives only computed scores, confidence, paradoxes, and safe metadata.
All draft items require pilot testing, reliability analysis, item-total correlation checks, and measurement-invariance review before high-stakes use.
